strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software bilong van sales na sales rep long rot
strings.tierB.home.description: Software bilong distribiuta: invois na risit long fon bilong rep, stok long ka, bungim mani, rot na visit. I wok taim i no gat intenet na i salim bihain.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Lukautim ol sales rep bilong yu, stat long namba wan visit i go inap long las mani yu bungim
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales em i wanpela klaud platfom (cloud) bilong ol kampani bilong distribiusen na holsel i gat ol sales rep long rot, wantaim salim stok long ka (van sales). Ol rep i mekim na printim invois na risit long fon bilong ol, lukautim stok long ka na raitim ol visit, na ol manesa i lukim ol sels, mani ol i bungim na dinau bilong ol kastoma long wankain taim em i kamap.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invois long fon bilong rep
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Rep i mekim invois long dua bilong kastoma na printim long Bluetooth thermal printa paslain long em i lusim stoa.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Bungim mani na dinau bilong kastoma
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Olgeta pemen i kisim risit i gat namba, i joim wantaim ol invois em i peim, na balans na stetmen bilong kastoma i senis kwiktaim.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Lukautim stok long ka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Stok bilong wanwan ka i stap long rekot, wanwan samting: ol i lodim, salim, ritan na wanem i stap yet; olsem sapos namba i no stret, yu lukim long dispela de stret.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Rot na visit
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ol visit i go long rekot wantaim ples, taim na foto, na rot bilong wanwan rep i kamap long map na manesa i lukim.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: I wok taim i no gat intenet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Ol rep i ken salim yet taim i no gat signal. Ol dokumen i wet long fon na i go otomatik, i no gat dabol, taim intenet i kam bek.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard bilong ol manesa
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sels, mani ol i bungim, ritan, stok na wok bilong wanwan rep i stap long wanpela ples, wantaim rol na pemisen bilong wanwan yusa.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tokim mipela olsem wanem yu salim
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Askim kwot o bukim miting. Mipela bai lukim ol rep, rot, prodak na ol nid bilong yu long invois.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Redim kampani bilong yu
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Putim ol prodak, prais, kastoma na rep, na setim kain mani na takis reit bilong kantri bilong yu long seting.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Salim ol rep i go long rot
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Ol rep i instolim app long Android o iPhone bilong ol, lodim ka na stat long salim, printim na bungim mani.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Bihainim de taim em i kamap
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web dashboard i soim sels, mani ol i bungim, stok long ka na ol visit, taim ol rep i stap yet long rot.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales em i wanpela klaud platfom bilong lukautim ol sales rep long rot long ol kampani bilong distribiusen na holsel. Em i karamapim salim stok long ka (van sales), salim long rot (route sales), kisim oda pastaim (pre-sales) na karim stok stret i go long stoa (DSD). Ol rep i mekim invois, printim, bungim mani na raitim visit long fon bilong ol, na ol manesa i bihainim sels, mani ol i bungim, stok long ka na dinau bilong ol kastoma long web dashboard.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales i save wok taim i no gat intenet?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yes. App bilong rep i wok yet taim i no gat intenet: ol rep i mekim na printim invois na risit, raitim visit na putim nupela kastoma, na olgeta samting i go otomatik, i no gat dabol, taim intenet i kam bek. I gat wanpela eksepsen long Saudi Arabia: ol kampani we i onim e-invoicing integreisen i nidim intenet long taim ol i mekim invois o ritan.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: FieldSales i wok long wanem ol kantri?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales i halivim ol kampani bilong distribiusen long olgeta kantri, Papua Niugini tu. Wanwan kampani i setim kain mani na takis reit bilong em long seting, na ol invois, risit na ripot i bihainim. Ofis bilong FieldSales i stap long Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, na redim kampani i kamap long intenet: long miting, WhatsApp na sapot long longwe.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales i save joim wantaim ol e-invoicing sistem bilong gavman?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Mipela i sapotim Phase 2 integreisen wantaim Fatoora platfom bilong ZATCA. Dispela em i bilong ol kampani long Saudi Arabia. Long ol narapela kantri, Papua Niugini tu, FieldSales i mekim invois wantaim kain mani na takis reit bilong yu, na joim wantaim nesenel e-invoicing sistem i stap sapos yu askim, bihain long mipela lukim wantaim yu ol rul bilong dispela kantri. Mipela i no promis olsem em bai bihainim ol rul bilong ol sistem ya ausait long Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: App bilong FieldSales i stap long wanem ol tok?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Intafes bilong FieldSales app i stap long ol tok ya tasol: Arabik, Inglis, Frens, Tekis na Sainis. Tok Pisin i no gat. Ol rep na manesa i ken senisim tok bilong intafes, na ol invois ol i printim i ken gat namba tu tok long sait bilong mein tok. Ol pes bilong websait long ol narapela tok, olsem dispela pes long Tok Pisin, em ol tanim tok bilong givim save long prodak tasol.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Olsem wanem bai mi stat wantaim FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Askim kwot, bukim miting o salim mesis long mipela long WhatsApp. Mipela i lainim olsem wanem ol rep bilong yu i wok, na bihain mipela i halivim yu long redim ol prodak, prais, kastoma na rep. Ol rep i instolim app long Android o iPhone, na ol manesa i yusim web dashboard long wanem brausa ol i laikim. Yu nidim smatfon tasol.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Intafes bilong FieldSales app i stap long ol tok ya tasol: Arabik, Inglis, Frens, Tekis na Sainis; Tok Pisin i no gat. Ol pes long ol narapela tok i stori long prodak bilong givim save tasol.
strings.tierB.category.title: Salim stok long ka: software bilong distribiuta | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales na route sales software: invois rep i printim long fon, stok long ka bilong wanwan prodak, bungim mani na visit. I wok taim i no gat intenet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Software bilong salim stok long ka, bilong ol distribiuta na holsel kampani
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales em i software bilong salim stok long ka (van sales) bilong ol kampani we ol rep bilong ol i salim stok long wanpela ka long rot olgeta de. Rep i lodim ka, salim long olgeta stoa, printim invois, bungim mani na raitim ol ritan, long wanpela app tasol long fon. Manesa i lukim wanem ol i lodim, salim, bungim na wanem i stap yet long wanwan ka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Software bilong salim stok long ka em i wanem?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Software bilong salim stok long ka, ol i kolim tu cash van o route sales software, i ranim wanpela pasin bilong salim we rep i karim stok long ka na em i salim, givim, mekim invois na bungim mani long wanpela visit tasol. Em i kisim ples bilong ol buk invois pepa na ol fon kol long pinis bilong de. Em i raitim olgeta sels, pemen na ritan olsem dokumen, olsem na yu ken sekim stok wantaim mani long dispela de stret. Long manesa, em i bekim tripela askim olgeta apinun: wanem samting wanwan rep i salim, wanem mani wanwan rep i bungim, na wanem i stap yet long wanwan ka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Wanpela de long rot
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: De i stat wantaim wanpela lod ol i raitim, i kam long wehaus i go long ka. Long wanwan stoa, rep i opim fail bilong kastoma, putim ol prodak long lis o wantaim barcode, mekim invois na printim long thermal printa. Pemen i go long rekot wantaim risit, na ritan i go long rekot wantaim as bilong en. Long pinis bilong de, samting i stap yet long ka i go bek long wehaus. Namel long ol dispela, manesa i bihainim sels, mani na visit bilong wanwan rep long web dashboard, i no nid long ringim wanpela man.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Mipela i wokim bilong ples we signal i no strong
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Ol rot bilong distribiusen i go long ol rum aninit long graun, ol hap bilong faktori na ol ples long bus we signal i no strong. FieldSales app bilong rep i holim ol kastoma, prodak na prais long fon, olsem na rep i ken mekim na printim dokumen taim i no gat intenet. Wanwan dokumen i gat ki i no wankain wantaim narapela, olsem na em i go long seva wanpela taim tasol, maski app i traim salim gen. Ol kampani long Saudi Arabia we i onim e-invoicing integreisen i nidim intenet long taim ol i mekim invois na ritan. Long ol tu, risit, visit na nupela kastoma i wok yet taim i no gat intenet.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Bungim mani na lukautim stok long ka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Mani long rot i nidim wankain kontrol olsem stok. Olgeta mani ol i bungim i kisim risit i gat namba we i ken joim wantaim ol invois em i peim, na balans bilong kastoma i senis kwiktaim. Ol i kaunim stok long ka bilong wanwan prodak: wanem ol i lodim, rausim wanem ol i salim, na putim ol ritan na ol adjasmen ol i raitim; olsem na ol manesa i ken sekim wantaim stok ol i kaunim long han paslain long rep i go long haus. Ol ritan i ken stap olsem nomol, bagarap o senisim, na manesa i makim sapos ol samting i kam bek i ken go bek long stok bilong salim long ka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Em i bilong husat?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales i fitim ol distribiuta na holsel kampani bilong ol prodak i save salim kwik, olsem kaikai, dring, prodak bilong klinim na prodak bilong lukautim bodi, na wanem kampani i gat ol rep i save visitim ol stoa long rot. Em i sapotim salim stok long ka, kisim oda pastaim na karim stok stret i go long stoa. Em i no wanpela ERP i karamapim olgeta wok bilong kampani: em i joim wantaim akaunting o ERP sistem bilong yu long wanpela API. Ol manesa i makim wanem samting wanwan rep i ken mekim, olsem givim daskaun, salim aninit long prais long lis o putim nupela kastoma.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Wanem i narapela kain namel long salim stok long ka na kisim oda pastaim?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Long salim stok long ka, rep i karim stok na long wankain visit em i givim, mekim invois na bungim mani. Long kisim oda pastaim, rep i kisim oda na wehaus i karim i go bihain. FieldSales i sapotim tupela, olsem na wanpela kampani i ken ranim cash van long sampela rot na kisim oda long ol narapela rot. Long tupela pasin, ol invois, mani na dinau bilong ol kastoma i stap long wanpela sistem, na ol manesa i lukim long wankain ripot.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Olsem wanem long sekim wanpela ka long pinis bilong de?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales i soim, bilong wanwan prodak long wanwan ka, hamas ol i lodim, salim, ritan na hamas i stap yet. Sekim namba i stap yet wantaim stok yu kaunim long han, sapos namba i no wankain, raitim olsem adjasmen, na kisim samting i stap yet i go bek long wehaus long wanpela muv tasol. Ka i stat long neks de wantaim klinpela balans yu save gut.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Wanem ol samting wanpela rep bilong ka i nidim?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Wanpela smatfon, Android o iPhone. Bluetooth thermal printa i no mas, tasol em i larim rep i givim invois o risit ol i printim long kastoma. FieldSales i no save salim ol masin na i no askim wanpela kain printa tasol. Ol manesa i yusim web dashboard long brausa bilong wanem kompiuta o fon.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales i ken joim wantaim akaunting sistem bilong mipela?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yes. FieldSales i givim wanpela API we i larim akaunting o ERP sistem bilong yu i salim na kisim kastoma, prodak, invois, risit na muv bilong stok wantaim platfom. Tim bilong yu o man i save wokim integreisen i wokim joim long API dokumentesen.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales long olgeta kantri: mani, takis, e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales i wok bilong ol distribiuta long olgeta kantri. Lukim kain mani, takis na e-invoicing bilong wanwan kantri long wanpela tebol.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales i halivim ol kampani bilong distribiusen long olgeta kantri. Wanwan kampani i makim kantri, kain mani na takis reit bilong em long seting, na ol invois, risit na ripot i bihainim. E-invoicing integreisen wantaim gavman i wok long Saudi Arabia tasol. Long olgeta narapela kantri, em i stap sapos yu askim. Tebol hia i soim, bilong wanwan kantri, kain mani bilong kantri, takis o VAT reit ol i save yusim, na sapos joim wantaim e-invoicing bilong gavman i wok pinis o i stap sapos yu askim.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Mipela i sapotim Phase 2 integreisen wantaim Fatoora platfom bilong ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Wanwan kampani i setim kain mani na takis reit long seting bilong em. Ol reit long dispela tebol em i bilong givim save tasol na ol i ken senis; sekim ol lo bilong nau wantaim man bilong givim yu advais long takis. Wanpela lain (—) i min olsem i no gat wanpela reit ol i raitim bilong dispela kantri.
strings.tierB.about.title: Stori bilong FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales i wokim klaud software bilong ol kampani bilong distribiusen i gat sales rep long rot. FieldSales i stat long 2026 long Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (nem bilong en long tok Arabik: فيلد سيلز) em i wanpela klaud platfom bilong ol kampani bilong distribiusen na holsel i gat sales rep long rot. Kampani FieldSales i stat long 2026 na i stap long Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Em i halivim ol kampani long olgeta kantri, na kain mani na takis reit bilong wanwan kantri i stap long seting bilong kampani. Ol kastoma bilong mipela em ol kampani i salim na karim stok long ol rep long rot: ol distribiuta, holsel kampani na ol faktori i gat ol salesman bilong ol yet.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Mipela i wokim wanpela sistem i joim olgeta wok long rot: invois rep i printim long fon, risit na dinau bilong ol kastoma, lukautim stok long ka, rot na visit wantaim ples na foto, na wanpela web dashboard bilong ol manesa. App bilong rep i wok long Android na iPhone, i wok yet taim i no gat intenet, na i salim otomatik taim intenet i kam bek. Ol kampani i ken joim FieldSales wantaim akaunting o ERP sistem bilong ol long wanpela API, olsem na ol i no nid long raitim tupela taim ol infomesen i kam long rot.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Mipela i tokaut long prodak olsem em i stap tru. Mipela i sapotim Phase 2 integreisen wantaim Fatoora platfom bilong ZATCA. Integreisen wantaim sistem bilong gavman long ol narapela kantri i stap sapos yu askim. Intafes bilong app i stap long ol tok ya: Arabik, Inglis, Frens, Tekis na Sainis; Tok Pisin i no gat. Bilong toktok wantaim mipela, askim kwot, bukim miting o salim mesis long mipela long WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Kontaktim FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Toktok wantaim tim bilong FieldSales: askim kwot, bukim miting o toktok long WhatsApp long software bilong sales rep na salim stok long ka.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tokim mipela olsem wanem ol rep bilong yu i salim nau na wanem samting yu laik senisim. Askim kwot, bukim miting o salim mesis long WhatsApp, na wanpela long tim bilong mipela bai bekim. Bilong sapot, ol kastoma i stap pinis i ken yusim wankain rot. I gutpela sapos yu tokim mipela kantri bilong yu, hamas rep yu gat, na sapos ol i salim long ka, kisim oda o mekim tupela.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bukim miting long intenet wantaim tim bilong mipela. Mipela bai soim wanpela de bilong rep long app na dashboard bilong manesa, wantaim ol eksampel i klostu long ol prodak na rot bilong yu, na bekim ol askim bilong yu long redim sistem.
